description: AWS CUR unblended spend for the last N days: total, daily average, and percent of monthly budget. Use when asked about AWS spend, monthly budget, or CUR totals.

configuration.query:
FROM metrics-aws_billing.cur-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - ?days::integer * 1 day
| STATS total_spend = SUM(aws_billing.cur.line_item.unblended_cost)
| EVAL lookback_days = ?days::integer
| EVAL avg_daily = total_spend / lookback_days
| EVAL monthly_budget_usd = 150000
| EVAL pct_of_budget = total_spend / monthly_budget_usd * 100

days.description: Lookback window in days (30 for budget questions, 7 for recent trends)

description: Top AWS linked accounts by CUR unblended cost over the last N days. Use for allocation / which account is driving spend.

configuration.query:
FROM metrics-aws_billing.cur-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - ?days::integer * 1 day
| STATS spend = SUM(aws_billing.cur.line_item.unblended_cost)
  BY account = aws_billing.cur.line_item.usage_account_name
| SORT spend DESC
| LIMIT 12

description: meridian-staging account spend over the last N days vs the daily SLO ceiling. Use when asked about staging cost leak, orphaned resources, or meridian-staging.

configuration.query:
FROM metrics-aws_billing.cur-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - ?days::integer * 1 day
  AND aws_billing.cur.line_item.usage_account_name == "meridian-staging"
| STATS spend = SUM(aws_billing.cur.line_item.unblended_cost)
| EVAL lookback_days = ?days::integer
| EVAL avg_daily = spend / lookback_days
| EVAL daily_slo_ceiling_usd = 150
| EVAL daily_alert_floor_usd = 200
| EVAL over_slo_ceiling = avg_daily > daily_slo_ceiling_usd

description: LLM cost from APM gen_ai spans by service.name over the last N days. Use for LLM burn, checkout-assistant, or app-level LLM FinOps.

configuration.query:
FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - ?days::integer * 1 day
  AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| EVAL cost = TO_DOUBLE(labels.llm_cost_usd)
| STATS spend_usd = SUM(cost), calls = COUNT(*)
  BY app = service.name, team = COALESCE(labels.team, "untagged")
| SORT spend_usd DESC
| LIMIT 15

days.description: Lookback window in days (7 for agent-loop questions)

description: Total cloud billing spend by provider (AWS CUR, GCP billing, Azure billing) over the last N days. Use for multi-cloud spend mix questions.

configuration.query:
FROM metrics-aws_billing.cur-default, metrics-gcp.billing-default, metrics-azure.billing-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - ?days::integer * 1 day
| EVAL spend = COALESCE(
    aws_billing.cur.line_item.unblended_cost,
    gcp.billing.total,
    azure.billing.pretax_cost)
| EVAL provider = CASE(
    data_stream.dataset == "aws_billing.cur", "aws",
    data_stream.dataset == "gcp.billing", "gcp",
    data_stream.dataset == "azure.billing", "azure",
    "other")
| STATS total = SUM(spend) BY provider
| SORT total DESC

description: GCP billing for meridian-ml-prod over the last N days. Use for ML platform burn or Vertex/GCE cost spike scenarios.

configuration.query:
FROM metrics-gcp.billing-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - ?days::integer * 1 day
  AND gcp.billing.project_name == "meridian-ml-prod"
| STATS spend = SUM(gcp.billing.total)
| EVAL lookback_days = ?days::integer
| EVAL alert_floor_usd = 4000
| EVAL over_alert_floor = spend > alert_floor_usd

description: Current Meridian spend SLO posture: error budget remaining and consumed. errorBudgetRemaining < 0 means violated. Use for SLO health questions.

configuration.query:
FROM .slo-observability.summary-v3.6
| WHERE slo.id LIKE "meridian-*"
| KEEP slo.id, slo.name, errorBudgetRemaining, errorBudgetConsumed, latestSliTimestamp
| EVAL violated = errorBudgetRemaining < 0
| SORT slo.name
